groups.activity: The Duviri Paradox, then The Hex

rows.label: The Hex
rows.note: unlocks Isleweaver, the fast Pathos Clamp duet

conditions: Without The Hex you're stuck fighting the full Duviri Experience Orowyrm for clamps instead of the much shorter Isleweaver duet.

groups.activity: kill The Fragmented, the duet's final boss
groups.meta: 10 clamps normal, 15 Steel Path, 8-20 min a run
conditions: The Fragmented is weak to Electricity — take the decree that adds elemental vulnerability if it's offered.
bonuses: Steel Path Duviri with its 3 bonus Undercroft portals pays 9 clamps instead of 10 from Isleweaver alone, plus Duviri arcanes and Steel Essence, if you'd rather combine clamps with resource gathering.

disclosures.title: if you fight the Orowyrm instead
disclosures.body: You don't have to ride the Kaithe in phase 2 — leave the arena to the sides and shoot the wyrmlings with your regular gun; Titania, Zephyr or Oraxia skip the flight segment in seconds. Don't fly in front of the breath attack, and shoot the orbs it throws for a speed boost.

groups.activity: mine, gather plants and loot Undercroft deposits

rows.label: Aggristone
rows.note: Aggristone Formations, Spiral objectives or the Circuit

rows.label: Kovnik
rows.note: plants across Duviri, sometimes inside Teshin's Cave

rows.label: Rune Marrow
rows.note: Runic Compact deposits in the Undercroft or Circuit; Corrupted Vor and Corrupted Jackal always drop it

conditions: Resource Boosters apply to Silphsela only, not Aggristone, Kovnik or Rune Marrow.
Grab a decree and gather resources in one Duviri Experience run rather than fighting the Orowyrm — Isleweaver is the better clamp farm.

groups.activity: buy the chamber from the Drifter melee vendor

rows.label: Sampotes
rows.note: grants the Drifter version plus a Warframe blueprint

conditions: If you sell the Warframe blueprint by mistake, Cephalon Simaris resells it for 100,000 standing — don't sell it.

rows.label: Sampotes
rows.note: 30,000 cr, 20 Silphsela, 30 Rune Marrow, 40 Kovnik, 150 Aggristone
